When Alex is clicking through a vendor console (Google Cloud etc.), give one short answer per screenshot: which option to pick and why, then the next click. He works step by step from screenshots.
Alex wants to stress-test against the future-state setup on the client's own billed account before a demo or go-live, rather than ship on borrowed infrastructure and migrate later.
Alex adds new secrets to the bottom of .env.local without touching existing lines, so check which duplicate key actually wins (Next uses the last) before claiming which key an environment runs on.
When several builder agents share one worktree on this 16 GB Mac, cap vitest at --maxWorkers=4, run one full suite at a time, and run tsc after vitest, never alongside.

Add the GOOGLE_MAPS_CI_KEY secret BEFORE pushing FS-474.

When keys or secrets span several places (local .env, GitHub, Heroku, Supabase), give Alex one table of which variable each place reads and which value goes where; he finds multi-console config confusing.
